candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite requiring: (1) denied/concealed pregnancy, (2) stillbirth delivery, (3) eclampsia (supported by hypertension 155/95, seizure, edema, elevated β-HCG with rapid drop suggesting delivery/fetal demise), and (4) PRES (supported by cortical/subcortical T2-hyperintensities on MRI). C001 mentions pregnancy-related complications and metrorrhagia but fails to specify eclampsia, PRES, stillbirth, or the denied/concealed pregnancy element. Metrorrhagia in this context likely represents lochia post-delivery rather than a primary diagnosis component.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures pregnancy-related complications but omits the denied pregnancy context, stillbirth delivery, eclampsia diagnosis, and PRES as required composite components

case_quality_flags: Denied pregnancy confirmed by markedly elevated β-HCG (16,140 IU/L) with 85% drop at 24 hours consistent with recent delivery/fetal demise
Cortical/subcortical T2-hyperintensities on MRI are the imaging hallmark of PRES, supporting eclampsia-PRES composite
Incidental findings (arachnoid cyst, hypothalamic hamartoma) may have contributed to seizure threshold but do not constitute the primary diagnosis
Normal fundoscopy does not exclude PRES; papilledema absence is consistent with PRES presentation
